documentation.content: The hourly `checkProviderBalances` found a prepaid provider's balance under its threshold in `config/runtime.providerBalanceAlerts` (`provider_balance_low`, with `provider`, `amount`, `unit`, `threshold`). Top it up before calls start failing as out of credit. Only providers with a balance probe and a threshold are checked; none by default. See functions/README.md, "Provider balances".
